actions.step: Check the over-etch time setting in the recipe for ETCH-03 chamber A.
Hold the current wafer and send it for inspection.
Stop the tool and notify process engineering.
Check whether the A-1023 alarms on 2026-11-11 were resolved and what was done, since the history shows no repair.

alarm_summary.recent_fix: No repair is recorded in the provided history.
alarm_summary.recent_alarm: A-1023 (chamber pressure high) was reported on ETCH-03 on 2026-11-11 at 10:05 in chamber A and at 10:30 in chamber B. A-1052 has not been reported on this tool in the last 7 days.

likely_causes: The over-etch time setting in the recipe is wrong or was changed, so the over-etch ran 14 s past the 90 s upper limit (104 s measured).
The endpoint was not detected during over-etch (SOP-016 applies), so the step ran until its time limit.
The earlier A-1023 pressure alarms on this tool on 2026-11-11 may be related. The history records no repair, so this is unconfirmed.
